Class MessagePackIO.Reader

java.lang.Object
io.fluxzero.common.serialization.MessagePackIO.Reader
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
Enclosing class:
MessagePackIO
public static final class MessagePackIO.Reader extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A reusable, zero-copy reader of one heap-array range. Closing releases the referenced array.
